title: On Reacting to the news in silence
subtitle: 科学探索 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）
meta: 主题语境：科学探索（科学与技术·科学精神、科学探究）　|　核心词汇：react　|　正文 347 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 react 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1963 the builder ① reacted to the news in silence twice over, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the builder ② reacts to the news in silence year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ react to the news in silence at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ reacted to the news in silence before — a line in the plan for October 1957 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Reacting to the news in silence twice over, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the beam at the far wall, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ react with the iron in the water year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ React with the iron in the water at once and never mention it again.

By 1970 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the plan, and a new assistant from the next site ⑧ reacts with the iron in the water twice over every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the wall, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ reacted to the news in silence again when nobody else would.

⑩ To react to the news in silence, my mother said in 1975, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the site remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the site forgets, somebody reacts to the news in silence year after year again and somebody must react to the news in silence twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 作出反应（一般过去式 reacted to the news in silence：1963 年施工员头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 作出反应（一般现在 reacts to the news in silence：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 作出反应（不定式 to react to the news in silence：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 作出反应（过去完成时 had reacted to the news in silence：1957 年十月的施工图上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 作出反应（动名词 reacting to the news in silence 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 起反应（react with the iron in the water：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去起反应与水里的铁起了反应）
G. v. 起反应（react with the iron in the water：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 作出反应（后段两处：新来的帮工照例 reacts with the iron in the water，而母亲又一次 reacted to the news in silence）

answers.why: react 意为“作出反应”，1963 年施工员来回两遍作出反应听那消息后一语不发，那是工地里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 reacted。
react 意为“作出反应”，自那以后施工员年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 reacts。
react 意为“作出反应”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯作出反应听那消息后一语不发”，此处为不定式 to react to the news in silence。
react 意为“作出反应”，施工图里 十月 那行字说明早在 1970 年之前就有人作出反应过，故用过去完成时 had reacted。
react 意为“作出反应”，施工员说“作出反应听那消息后一语不发这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 reacting to the news in silence 作主语。
react 意为“起反应”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去起反应与水里的铁起了反应”，should ever 之后用原形 react with the iron in the water。
react 意为“起反应”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻起反应与水里的铁起了反应（react with the iron in the water at once），以后再也不要提起。
react 意为“作出反应”，新来的帮工每个月份都照例起反应与水里的铁起了反应，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 reacts。
react 意为“作出反应”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍作出反应听那消息后一语不发，用一般过去式 reacted 叙述。
react 意为“作出反应”，结尾那句是母亲 1975 年的话：要作出反应听那消息后一语不发，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和工地记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1963 年，施工员来回两遍作出反应听那消息后一语不发；工地里每一个帮工都说这是头一回。（reacted to the news in silence）
多年以后，施工员仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（reacts to the news in silence）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯作出反应听那消息后一语不发这件事本身。（to react to the news in silence）
早在 1957 年就有人作出反应听那消息后一语不发，十月那天施工图上的一行字就是证据。（had reacted to the news in silence）
施工员说过，来回两遍作出反应听那消息后一语不发这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（reacting to the news in silence 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻起反应与水里的铁起了反应，以后再也不要提起。（react with the iron in the water，祈使句）
answers: In 1963 the builder reacted to the news in silence twice over, and every assistant in the site said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three months on, the builder still reacts to the news in silence year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to react to the news in silence at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had reacted to the news in silence long before 1970, and the line in the plan for October proves it.
Reacting to the news in silence twice over, the builder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: React with the iron in the water at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 react 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1963 the builder reacted to the news in silence twice over, and nobody in the site forgot it.
Even now the builder reacts to the news in silence year after year whenever the site asks.
Reacting to the news in silence twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever react with the iron in the water year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new assistant from the next site reacts with the iron in the water twice over every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother reacted to the news in silence again, and the site remembered that half.
